days.label: Push Day ? Chest, Shoulders & Triceps
days.warmup: 5 min light cardio + arm circles + band pull-aparts

exercises.name: Barbell Bench Press
exercises.notes: Seven weeks. Seven straight weeks at 135 with zero logs. I've said everything there is to say. The weight stays at 135 ? it will stay here indefinitely until you give me something to work with. Touch the chest, full 1-second pause at the bottom, drive through the heels, stay braced the entire set. Need 9-10 reps across all three sets at RPE 7 or lower to earn 140. Log every set, every rep, every RPE. If you walked in and did this today, you'd probably move up next week. That's how simple this is.

exercises.name: Incline Dumbbell Press
exercises.notes: Seven weeks at 45 with no logs. Still here. 30-degree incline, elbows at 45 degrees, 2-second negative on every rep. Need 10/10/10 at RPE 7 to earn 50. The old data showed rep drops across sets ? save something in the tank so set 3 doesn't collapse. Log it.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Shoulder Press
exercises.notes: Seven weeks at 35 with no logs. Last known data showed RPE 9 across all three sets ? you were at the limit every rep. That's not owning the weight. Check your seat height and setup before rep one, press straight up, full lockout at the top, no lean back. Need all three sets at RPE 7-8 to earn the bump. Log it.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Front Raise
exercises.notes: ROTATION IN ? swapping back from Lateral Raise this week. Lateral raise was in last week with no log. Front raise returns: raise to shoulder height, slight elbow bend, controlled 2-second negative, don't use momentum or rock your torso. Alternate arms or do both together ? your call. Pick a weight where 10-12 reps is RPE 7 and log it. Baseline session.

exercises.name: Close-Grip Bench Press
exercises.notes: Seven weeks at 95 with no logs. Hands shoulder-width, elbows tucked tight throughout, lower to the chest, full lockout on every rep. Log this session and 100 lbs is yours next week. It's been seven weeks of waiting. Just log it.

exercises.name: Tricep Rope Pushdown
exercises.notes: ROTATION IN ? swapping out Dumbbell Overhead Tricep Extension this week. Overhead extension was in last week with no log. Rope pushdown: elbows pinned to your sides, split the rope at the bottom, full extension on every rep, 2-second controlled return. Don't let your elbows drift forward. Pick a weight where 10-12 reps is RPE 7 and log it. Baseline session.

days.cooldown: Stretch chest, shoulders, and triceps ? 5 min

days.label: Pull Day ? Back, Biceps & Rear Delts
days.warmup: 5 min light cardio + band pull-aparts + cat-cow stretches

exercises.name: Barbell Deadlift
exercises.notes: Seven weeks at 195. Seven weeks of silence. Last real data ? 8/8/8 at RPE 8/8/9 ? told me set 3 was already at the edge, and that data is ancient. Lats tight before you break the floor, bar dragging up the shins, big breath and brace before every single rep, full lockout at the top. Take the full 2 minutes between sets. Need 8+ reps on all three sets at RPE 7 or lower to earn 205. Log it.

exercises.name: Lat Pulldown
exercises.notes: Seven weeks at 110 without a single log. Last session showed 10/9/8 at RPE 7/8/8 ? losing reps and gaining effort across sets. Wide grip, pull to upper chest, hard lat squeeze at the bottom, stay upright ? do not let your torso row it down. Need 10/10/10 at RPE 7 to earn 120. Log every set.

exercises.name: Barbell Bent-Over Row
exercises.notes: ROTATION IN ? swapping out Dumbbell Single-Arm Row this week. Dumbbell row was in last week with no log. Barbell bent-over row: hinge at the hips, back flat and nearly parallel to the floor, pull the bar to your lower chest ? not your stomach, not your collarbone. Squeeze the shoulder blades at the top, controlled descent. Pick a weight where 8-10 reps is RPE 7 and log it. Baseline session.

exercises.name: Cable Face Pull
exercises.notes: Seven weeks at 70 with no logs. Last known session was 12/12/12 at RPE 7/8/8 ? set 1 clean, sets 2 and 3 climbing in effort. Rope at upper pulley, pull to your face, thumbs pointing behind you at the finish, elbows high, full external rotation at the end. Need 15/15/15 at RPE 7 to earn 75. Push the rep count on every set.

exercises.name: EZ Bar Curl
exercises.notes: ROTATION IN ? swapping out Hammer Curl this week. Hammer curl was in last week with no log. EZ bar curl: elbows pinned to your sides, strict form ? no swinging, no body English. The EZ bar is easier on the wrists than a straight bar. Full curl to the top, 2-second controlled negative. Pick a weight where 8-10 reps is RPE 7 and log it. Baseline session.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Curl
exercises.notes: Seven weeks of no logs. Still at 25 lbs. If it's too easy, great ? log it and tell me and I'll bump it immediately. If it's too hard, log it and tell me. Elbows pinned, supinate at the top, 2-second negative. The weight doesn't matter as much as the data. Give me something to work with.

days.cooldown: Stretch lats, biceps, and upper back ? 5 min

days.label: Leg Day ? Quads, Hamstrings, Glutes & Core
days.warmup: 5 min light cardio + bodyweight squats + leg swings

exercises.name: Barbell Back Squat
exercises.notes: Seven weeks at 165. Seven weeks without a single log. Last real data was 8/8/8 at RPE 8/8/8 ? stuck at 8 reps, stuck at RPE 8, and that was nearly two months ago. Below parallel, big breath before you unrack, brace hard, drive through the heels, chest up out of the hole. Take the full 2 minutes between sets. Need 9-10 reps on all three sets at RPE 7 or under to earn 175. Show up. Do the work. Log it.

exercises.name: Romanian Deadlift
exercises.notes: Seven weeks at 155, no logs. Last session was 10/9/10 at RPE 7/8/8 ? set 1 great, sets 2 and 3 losing reps and climbing in effort. Slight knee bend, hips back, bar close to the legs the whole way down, feel the hamstring stretch at the bottom, don't round the lower back. Need 10/10/10 at RPE 7 to earn 165. Rest the full 90 seconds ? that's where sets 2 and 3 fall apart.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Walking Lunges
exercises.notes: ROTATION IN ? swapping out Bulgarian Split Squat this week. Split squat was in last week with no log. Walking lunges: long stride for more glute involvement, short stride for more quad ? pick one and stay consistent. Keep your torso upright, front shin vertical at the bottom, drive through the front heel on the way up. Pick a weight per hand where 10-12 reps per leg is RPE 7 and log it. Baseline session.

exercises.name: Barbell Hip Thrust
exercises.notes: Seven weeks at 85 with no logs. Last session was 12/10/10 at RPE 8/8/8 ? set 1 hit 12 but sets 2 and 3 fell to 10 with high effort throughout. Upper back on the bench, barbell padded across your hips, drive through the heels, full hip extension at the top, squeeze hard for a full second, controlled descent. Need 12/12/12 at RPE 7 to earn 90. Rest the full 75 seconds between sets.

exercises.name: Leg Extension
exercises.notes: ROTATION IN ? swapping out Leg Curl this week. Leg curl was in last week with no log. Leg extension on the leg attachment: squeeze the quads hard at the top, hold for a half-second, 2-second controlled negative on the way down ? don't let the weight drop. Pick a weight where 12-15 reps is RPE 7 and log it. Baseline session.

exercises.name: Cable Crunch
exercises.notes: Still at 40 lbs ? no log came back last week. Kneel facing the pulley, rope behind your head, crunch down using your abs ? not your hips, not your arms. The movement comes from your abs contracting. Pause at the bottom, control the return. If 40 is too easy or too hard, log it and tell me. Give me something to work with.

days.cooldown: Stretch quads, hamstrings, hip flexors ? 5 min
